lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples to be dressed for service and keep lamps burning, like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet.
The master finds his servants on watch, so he dresses himself to serve and waits on them at the table.
Jesus says the Son of Man will come at an unexpected hour, and Andrew asks whether the parable is for them or everyone.
The faithful manager gives the servants their portion on time, but the one who says the master is delayed is welcomed by the master with a feast.

wrong_details.wrong: welcomed by the master with a feast
wrong_details.true: cut to pieces and assigned a place with the unbelievers

lines.text: The servant who knows his master's will but does not get ready is beaten with many blows, and from those given much, much is required.
